verdict.rationale: Authy documents encrypted cloud backup for when you lose your phone, multi-device sync, and adding a new device via SMS, voice, or approval from an existing device. Together these move all tokens to a new phone within the app. Community reports confirm multi-device sync and recovery work; complaints about exporting apply to leaving Authy, not to switching phones within it. Missing for 10: documentation of a single guided transfer flow, hands-on reports of a phone-to-phone move, and confirmation that every token type restores intact.
